purpose: Editorial ghost lanes. Each lane is an editorial contract and not a fabricated person, biography or separate public author.

japan_reality.purpose: Explain Japan from a grounded inside perspective without tourism cliches, fetishization, sensationalism or unsupported national generalisation.
banned_patterns: the truth Japan does not want you to know
japan_reality.generalisation_rule: Broad claims about Japan or Japanese people require public evidence. Otherwise scope the claim narrowly.
japan_reality.notes: Grounded observation beats confident national generalisation.

independent_builder.purpose: Read AI tools, launches, automation and market changes through one question: what does this actually change for a solo operator?
banned_patterns: here is everything you need to know about
independent_builder.generalisation_rule: No first-hand testing may be claimed unless the source proves it.
independent_builder.notes: The value is implication, not announcement.

practical_operator.purpose: Solve a concrete work problem close to real intent and purchase behaviour.
practical_operator.generalisation_rule: No fake client stories, invented ROI, manufactured urgency or guaranteed-income framing.
practical_operator.notes: Closest to purchase behaviour, so fabrication rules are strictest.

structural_reflection.purpose: Preserve the non-commodity layer: structural thinking about work, AI, people, systems and incentives.
banned_patterns: you need to understand this now
structural_reflection.generalisation_rule: Preserve nuance; do not flatten strong material into listicle or SEO filler.

evidence_auditor.purpose: Take viral AI or business claims apart into verified facts, plausible inference, unknowns and unsupported claims while preserving the useful signal.
evidence_auditor.generalisation_rule: Screenshots, social posts and self-reported metrics are claims unless independently verified.
evidence_auditor.notes: Optimized for trust, freshness and safe trend capture.

workflow_mechanic.purpose: Turn a trend or tool announcement into an implementation map: inputs, state, permissions, failure modes, human gates and measurable outputs.
workflow_mechanic.generalisation_rule: Distinguish a proposed architecture from a production-verified implementation.
workflow_mechanic.notes: Best fit for reusable systems and implementation products.

economic_skeptic.purpose: Interrogate AI claims through unit economics: subscription cost, usage cost, failure cost, review time, displacement value and break-even conditions.
economic_skeptic.generalisation_rule: Do not invent ROI. State assumptions and separate listed prices from estimated operating cost.
economic_skeptic.notes: Useful for high-intent buyers who distrust hype.

opportunity_mapper.purpose: Translate a new capability into concrete adjacent opportunities, who benefits, what changes, what remains hard and which opportunities are premature.
opportunity_mapper.generalisation_rule: Opportunity is not proof of demand; distinguish capability, demand evidence and monetization evidence.
opportunity_mapper.notes: Designed for PV plus future product discovery without forcing a sale.

derivation_rule.explanation: Do not generate every lens for every source. Score evidence fit, audience fit, revenue fit, freshness, truth risk, duplicate risk and operational burden; derive only the strongest one to three angles.
